description: API Gateway Denial of Service The application exposes public API endpoints through API Gateway. Without proper rate limiting and throttling, an attacker could send a massive number of requests to exhaust resources. An attacker uses distributed botnets to send thousands of requests per second to the API endpoints, overwhelming the service and preventing legitimate users from accessing the application.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1498 - Network Denial of Service
mitreATT&CK: T1499 - Endpoint Denial of Service
recommendation: Implement AWS WAF with rate limiting rules
recommendation: Enable API Gateway throttling and quotas

description: Overly Permissive IAM Roles Lambda functions and other services are using roles that may have more permissions than necessary, increasing the attack surface if compromised. If a Lambda function is compromised through code injection, an attacker could leverage overly permissive IAM roles to access or modify resources beyond the function's intended scope.
references: recommendation: Implement least privilege IAM policies

description: Sensitive Data Exposure in OpenSearch OpenSearch domains store photo metadata and search indices. Without proper access controls and encryption, sensitive data could be exposed. An attacker gains access to the OpenSearch domain and extracts sensitive metadata about users' photos, including location data or facial recognition results.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1213 - Data from Information Repositories

description: Insecure Cache Data Storage The Redis cache stores data in memory without encryption, potentially exposing sensitive information if the cache is compromised. An attacker gains network access to the Redis instance and dumps the cache contents, accessing sensitive user data or session information.

Image Processing Resource Exhaustion The application processes uploaded images through Lambda functions without proper size or rate limiting, potentially allowing resource exhaustion. An attacker uploads many large images simultaneously, causing high Lambda concurrency and SQS queue flooding.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1499 - Endpoint Denial of Service

description: Unauthorized Search Access Search functionality might not properly scope results to the authenticated user's context, allowing access to other users' private content. An authenticated user modifies search parameters to access photos and metadata belonging to other users.
